# pve_node_capabilities (Data Source)

Merges the QEMU capabilities of one node: available CPU models (`GET /nodes/{node}/capabilities/qemu/cpu`), machine types (`GET /nodes/{node}/capabilities/qemu/machines`), and migration capabilities (`GET /nodes/{node}/capabilities/qemu/migration`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_node_capabilities" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name whose capabilities to read.

### Read-Only

- `cpu_models` (Attributes List) All default and custom CPU models usable by VMs on this node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cpu_models))
- `id` (String) Identifier in `node` form (same as the `node` attribute).
- `machines` (Attributes List) Available QEMU/KVM machine types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machines))
- `migration_features` (Attributes List) Single-element list carrying the node's QEMU live-migration capabilities. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--migration_features))

<a id="nestedatt--cpu_models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cpu_models`

Read-Only:

- `abstract` (Boolean) Whether this is a PVE-internal abstract profile (e.g. `x86-64-v2`) that cannot be used as a custom model's `reported-model`; null when not reported.
- `custom` (Boolean) Whether this is a custom CPU model.
- `name` (String) The CPU model name, prefixed with `custom-` for custom models.
- `vendor` (String) The CPU vendor visible to the guest when this model is selected.


<a id="nestedatt--machines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machines`

Read-Only:

- `changes` (String) Notable changes of the version, currently only set for `+pveX` versions; null otherwise.
- `id` (String) Full name of machine type and version (e.g. `pc-q35-8.0`).
- `type` (String) The machine type: `q35` or `i440fx`.
- `version` (String) The machine version (e.g. `8.0`).


<a id="nestedatt--migration_features"></a>
### Nested Schema for `migration_features`

Read-Only:

- `has_dbus_vmstate` (Boolean) Whether the host supports live-migrating additional VM state via the dbus-vmstate helper.
